title: Focusing on the AI Big Picture with Moores Lab AI at DAC 2026 - Semiwiki
gist: At DAC 2026 Moores Lab AI, founded 2025, showcased its MooreIP agentic-AI suite spanning the chip design flow; CEO Shelly Henry argues generic AI lacks engineering precision and that pervasive IP reuse makes debug, verification and accurate specs the critical bottlenecks.

insights.claim: DAC 2026 demonstrated that agentic AI design flows are here to stay, conveyed by both familiar EDA companies and new entrants to the industry.
insights.speaker: Mike Gianfagna
insights.so_what: Signals a structural shift in EDA toward agentic automation across the design flow.

insights.claim: Moores Lab AI, founded in 2025, has two companies using its tools in production and more than 30 additional companies working toward production deployment.
insights.speaker: Mike Gianfagna
insights.so_what: Early but real adoption metric for a young agentic-EDA entrant.

insights.claim: Current AI models cannot deliver the precision required for engineering applications such as chip design, and Moores Lab AI fills the gap by automating the hundreds of skills required to reach a successful tapeout.
insights.speaker: Shelly Henry
insights.so_what: Positions domain-specific agents as the differentiator versus general-purpose LLMs.

insights.claim: The MooreIP suite comprises DebugAgent, CoverageAgent, VerifAgent and the newly launched SpecAgent, with VerifAgent claiming to collapse 7+ months of functional verification into one month.
insights.speaker: Mike Gianfagna
insights.so_what: Verification time compression is the core ROI claim to validate with customers.
insights.quote: Collapses 7+ months of functional verification into 1 month.

themes.theme: IP reuse shifts value to spec, debug, verification

insights.claim: Pervasive IP reuse makes integration and validation of existing designs more prevalent than designing from scratch, making debug, verification and the accuracy of specifications the critical challenges.
insights.speaker: Shelly Henry
insights.so_what: SpecAgent targets the garbage-in/garbage-out spec problem underpinning reuse-driven design.

insights.claim: The rising cost of tokens is becoming a challenge, and by focusing on engineering details Moores Lab AI aims to improve the ROI of agentic flows and manage runaway token use.
insights.speaker: Shelly Henry
insights.so_what: Token economics gate the viability of agentic EDA at scale.
